ordinary.intro_inv:
V/ O Lord, thou wilt open my lips.
R/ And my mouth shall declare thy praise.
ordinary.intro:
V/ O God, come to my assistance.
R/ O Lord, make haste to help me.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.
As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
Alleluia.

ordinary.gloria:
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, *
  and to the Holy Spirit.
As it was in the beginning, is now, *
  and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
ordinary.dismissal:
! When a priest or deacon presides, he dismisses the people with a blessing. Otherwise:
Dominus nos benedicat, et ab omni malo defendat, et ad vitam aeternam perducat.
R/ Amen.
ordinary.conclusion:
V/ Benedicamus Domino.
R/ Deo gratias.
ordinary.examen: ! A brief examination of conscience may be made here. In a common celebration, a penitential act may follow.
ordinary.blessing:
Noctem quietam et finem perfectum concedat nobis Dominus omnipotens.
R/ Amen.
ordinary.marian@advent:
Alma Redemptoris Mater, quae pervia caeli
porta manes, et stella maris, succurre cadenti,
surgere qui curat, populo: tu quae genuisti,
natura mirante, tuum sanctum Genitorem,
Virgo prius ac posterius, Gabrielis ab ore
sumens illud Ave, peccatorum miserere.
ordinary.marian@lent:
Ave, Regina caelorum,
Ave, Domina angelorum:
Salve, radix, salve, porta,
Ex qua mundo lux est orta:
Gaude, Virgo gloriosa,
Super omnes speciosa,
Vale, o valde decora,
Et pro nobis Christum exora.
ordinary.marian@easter:
Regina caeli, laetare, alleluia.
Quia quem meruisti portare, alleluia.
Resurrexit, sicut dixit, alleluia.
Ora pro nobis Deum, alleluia.
ordinary.marian@ordinary:
Salve, Regina, mater misericordiae,
vita, dulcedo, et spes nostra, salve.
Ad te clamamus exsules filii Hevae,
ad te suspiramus, gementes et flentes
in hac lacrimarum valle.
Eia, ergo, advocata nostra,
illos tuos misericordes oculos ad nos converte;
et Iesum, benedictum fructum ventris tui,
nobis post hoc exsilium ostende.
O clemens, O pia, O dulcis Virgo Maria.
